tagline.en_US: File management and sharing with WebDAV, multiple users and storage on local disks, S3-compatible services or OneDrive.

description.en_US: Cloudreve is a self-hosted file management system that supports multiple storage providers. It allows users to store files across local disks, remote nodes, OneDrive, and S3-compatible cloud services with direct client-to-storage transmission. The platform includes WebDAV support, multi-user and group management, and background downloading via Aria2 or qBittorrent. It also enables in-browser document editing and media previewing.
